verdict.rationale: Lithic is a programmatic API (llms.txt describes a "predictable and programmatic interface"), so it runs headlessly by design. Its sandbox mirrors production and runs cards, transactions, and webhooks end-to-end, with simulation endpoints for authorizations, which fits automated test pipelines. Dated API versioning lets automation pin behavior. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance or examples, a documented CLI or headless tooling, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
